details.description: Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct is Qwen's largest coding-specialized model, a mixture-of-experts model with 480 billion total parameters and 35 billion activated per token (160 experts, 8 active), released July 22, 2025. It is built for agentic coding, agentic browser-use, and agentic tool-use, with a native 262,144-token context window (extendable to 1 million tokens via Yarn) and repository-scale code understanding. Qwen's launch blog describes its results on these agentic tasks among open models as 'comparable to Claude Sonnet 4.' It runs in non-thinking mode only.
advantages: Scores 38.7 on SWE-bench Pro's public dataset, a software-engineering benchmark (Scale AI's SWE-bench Pro leaderboard).
Qwen's launch blog describes its results on Agentic Coding, Agentic Browser-Use, and Agentic Tool-Use as 'comparable to Claude Sonnet 4' among open models.
Native 262,144-token context window, extendable to 1 million tokens using Yarn (Qwen's model card).
Integrates with Qwen Code and Cline for IDE-based agentic coding workflows.
disadvantages: Non-thinking mode only; does not generate <think></think> reasoning blocks (Qwen's model card).
480B total parameters (35B active) are far larger than the 30B-A3B sibling model, requiring proportionally more compute to serve.
use_cases: Autonomous coding agents for multi-step software development tasks
Agentic browser-use tasks driven by a coding agent
Tool-calling and function-calling workflows via OpenAI-compatible APIs

notes: Catalog facts (262,144 max input/output tokens) match Qwen's native context spec and are consistent with Fireworks' own page (~262,000 tokens) for this exact model ID, so no conflict to flag. Verification pass: neither the HF model card nor Qwen's blog/GitHub actually contains a benchmark table (no model-index on HF, no scores in the README text) despite the researcher citing the HF card for SWE-bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 2.0 scores. SWE-bench Pro 38.7 was independently confirmed on Scale AI's public SWE-bench Pro leaderboard for 'qwen3-coder-480b-a35b' (exact match) and re-sourced there. Terminal-Bench 2.0 23.9 could not be confirmed on any current or archived maker or third-party page (Terminal-Bench's own site now only shows v4.0; Wayback Machine had no snapshot) and was removed. A third benchmark on Qwen's model card ('EvasionBench', 78.16) was already left out of evaluations by the researcher: it is not a benchmark we could independently verify, and its scoring direction is unclear.
